text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The summit seems close, yet so far. If I 
do not accept this reality, I will be 
swallowed by eternal recurrence.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...We are challengers. A strong 
individual transmutes wax into gold, 
ascending to the heavens."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, victory and defeat are neither fate 
nor prophecy! Sever causality with your 
own power!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I shall remain an insatiable seeker!
I'll 
hone my aesthetics and elevate them into 
inevitability!!"
